idea-plugin.name: Duplicate Image Finder
idea-plugin.description:
Find identical and similar static PNG, JPEG, and WebP images across project modules.

Compare images side by side, inspect dimensions, paths, HEX colors, and pairwise differences. Discover resized copies and differently tinted monochrome artwork, including combinations of both.

Automatically check saved image changes and notify you of new matches. Visual matches are suggestions, not deletion recommendations. No files are modified.

Open View > Tool Windows > Duplicate Image Finder.
